reference.title: Indice de VOC da Sensirion
reference.note: Manufacturer technical reference. VOC Index is a relative index and not a regulatory concentration limit.

parameterDefinition.name: VOC Index
parameterDefinition.description: Relative VOC index used as an operational indicator; it is not a direct VOC concentration.
parameterDefinition.measurementMethod: Sensirion Gas Index Algorithm relative index derived from recent environmental baseline.

criteria.methodNote: Sensirion VOC Index is an operational relative index. Values above the documented baseline of 100 indicate a relative deterioration from the recent environmental baseline; this is not a regulatory concentration limit.

curation.curationNotes: Curated from existing reference catalog and current regulatory semantics. VOC Index remains a relative manufacturer technical indicator and not a concentration or regulatory threshold.
